ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is a coordinate graph, with the horizontal axis labeled MINUTES and the vertical axis labeled MILES. The straight line passes through the origin, and several points can be read on the graph: 5 minutes corresponds to 1 mile, 10 minutes corresponds to 2 miles, 15 minutes corresponds to 3 miles, and 20 minutes corresponds to 4 miles. Then reason: Because this is uniform speed, it shows that distance and time are directly proportional. From the graph, the speed is 1 mile / 5 minutes. Half an hour is 30 minutes, so 30 ÷ 5 = 6, and 6 miles were ridden.

method.method_draft: Read the graph as miles versus minutes: the plotted straight line passes through points such as 5 minutes = 1 mile, 10 minutes = 2 miles, 15 minutes = 3 miles, and 20 minutes = 4 miles. From the text, use that Suzanna continues at the same constant speed for half an hour, meaning 30 minutes. Compute the unit rate from the graph, e.g. 1 mile per 5 minutes, then apply it to 30 minutes: 30 ÷ 5 = 6 miles.
